title: Chapter 343 Going To Lin'S House Alone
content:
Chapter 343 Going To Lin'S House Alone

Mr. Jiang is also addicted to drinking.

To be precise, Lu Daosheng loves drinking so much, most of the time he is influenced by Mr. Jiang.

Mr. Jiang's disease is probably part of the reason for drinking.

However, Jiang Xiaoxiao opposed it: "If you don't believe it, grandpa has just recovered, how can he drink?"

Upon hearing this, before Lu Daosheng could speak, Mr. Jiang smiled and said, "Xiaoxiao, grandpa just drink one cup, just one cup, it won't be a problem."

"Not even a cup!"

Seeing that Jiang Xiaoxiao didn't let go, Old Master Jiang had to look at Lu Daosheng helplessly.

Sometimes, he really has no choice but to do this, his granddaughter.

"Xiaoxiao, the old man is fine now. Drinking some wine is harmless."

Lu Daosheng said with a faint smile.

"Brother Sheng, why do you even say such things? Grandpa finally got better."

Seeing that both of them were so persistent, Jiang Xiaoxiao was immediately angry.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already brought a bottle of wine on his own.

It's very average, but the important thing is who to drink with.

"My grandpa, there is no good wine now, I will bring you some good next time."

Mr. Jiang was a little angry when he saw his granddaughter. He wanted to forget it, but Lu Daosheng had already taken out the wine, which made him very hungry.

He hasn't drunk alcohol for three years, so how could he bear it? He doesn't care about the wine.

"Come on."

Soon, a glass of wine was filled.

Jiang Xiaoxiao, who was beside her, snorted, and muttered: I'm too lazy to care about you.

I don't know how long it took.

A bottle of wine was finished quickly.

But where did you drink enough of two wines?

"Xiaoxiao, go, buy another bottle for grandpa, buy a better one."

Mr. Jiang waved and signaled Jiang Xiaoxiao who had finished his meal.

Upon hearing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao gave the two a blank look and went out to buy wine helplessly.

No accident, something is about to happen.

Lu Daosheng and Mr. Jiang waited at home for a long time, but they didn't wait until Jiang Xiaoxiao came back.

"This girl, why is it so hard to buy a wine?"

Mr. Jiang said a little dissatisfied.

Just as I can drink it, I am happy.

In response to this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I'll go out and take a look, so that Xiaoxiao will not have anything to do with her."

Upon hearing this, Mr. Jiang nodded slightly, "Okay, you go and have a look."

......

"Miss Jiang, you know Mr. Lin's intentions. After following Mr. Lin early, you don't have to live like this again."

Several gangster-like people took Jiang Xiaoxiao to a small alley and surrounded him firmly.

The person in charge wanted to touch Jiang Xiaoxiao's pretty face with his fingers.

But it was Jiang Xiaoxiao who hid.

"You guys get out of the way, I have no interest in Lin Xu."

Jiang Xiaoxiao's face was cold and she stared at the few people tightly.

Hearing this, the leader snorted coldly and said, "Jiang Xiaoxiao, don't be rude. Your grandfather was hospitalized and invited so many famous doctors to see him during this period. Do you think you invited him? That's not Mr. Lin himself. Found it."

"Your villas and companies were purchased by Mr. Lin himself. I wonder how much subsidies you have given during this period. Are you embarrassed?"

"That's right, Miss Jiang, if it weren't for Young Master Lin, your grandfather would have been burping a long time ago."

"Shut up!"

Jiang Xiaoxiao shouted coldly.

Lin Xu did provide assistance when their Jiang family was in trouble, but Jiang Xiaoxiao refused, and later wrote an IOU to Lin Xu and promised to pay it back in the future.

How could she agree with her body?

"I will return what Lin Xu gave me, and I will redeem my Jiang family's property."

"Also, my grandfather has recovered, you can leave."

Hearing Jiang Xiaoxiao's words, the few people looked at each other, their eyes full of shock.

Mr. Jiang is actually getting better.

How is this possible?

Don’t those famous doctors say that Mr. Jiang’s death is just a matter of time. At most, spending money will take a few years.

Why did this suddenly get better?

And at this moment, a cold voice sounded from afar.

"What are you doing?"

Everyone was shocked and suddenly felt that the air around them had become much colder.

Looking in the sound, I saw a man staring at them tightly. His eyes were extremely deep, so they didn't dare to look directly.

"Who are you?"

"Brother!"

Jiang Xiaoxiao took advantage of the shock of the few people and hurriedly ran out of the encirclement and came to Lu Daosheng.

"Xiaoxiao, you go home first."

"But,,"

"go home."

"OK."

Immediately, Jiang Xiaoxiao held the wine she had just bought and hurriedly ran towards the home.

After Jiang Xiaoxiao left, Lu Daosheng slowly looked at these gangsters.

In response to this, Lu Daosheng didn't even say a word of nonsense and took action.

The violent fighting sounds in imagination did not sound.

In just a moment, these people lay on the ground with pain and started moaning.

Lu Daosheng grabbed someone casually and said coldly: "Tell me, what do you want to do to Jiang Xiaoxiao?"

"I dare to tell a lie, I will make you worse than death!"

The man had no doubt about Lu Daosheng's words, and his eyes were full of horror.

"Brother, no, uncle, I said, I said everything!"

Immediately, Lu Daosheng learned about Lin Xu's pursuit of Jiang Xiaoxiao.

"Uncle, that's it. We just work."

The man looked pitiful, with a pleading in his eyes.

Lu Daosheng also quickly understood what was going on.

"Tell me, where is the Lin family?"

......

Lin family.

On this day, an uninvited guest came to the Lin family.

"Stop, what are you doing?!"

A tall security guard stopped a man with a cold expression.

He was about to scold him, but suddenly he felt a dizzy turn.

When he came to his senses, he had been lying on the ground at some point, his whole body was in unbearable pain and he had no strength.

"Ah!! What's going on?"

Another security guard on the side witnessed everything and was shocked. He just watched the man who suddenly broke in and walked straight into the Lin family's door.

When he realized it, he could no longer see the other person's back.

"Master Ma, a man broke into the outside. It's very strange. The other party has already entered. The person who came is not kind."

The security guard took out the intercom and said in a trembling voice.

Soon, a cold voice came from the walkie-talkie.

"knew."

And at this time, the Lin family.

Bang bang bang!

Several more thugs who blocked the road were knocked over to the ground.

Lu Daosheng has been unobstructed all the way.

Lu Daosheng's arrogant behavior finally attracted the attention of the senior management of the Lin family.

"It's really no one dared to come to my Lin family for many years."

Calmness and words that cannot be ignored sounded from the huge villa in front of me.

Immediately afterwards, an old man with a crutch walked out slowly with the help of a gentle girl.

Beside him, an old man in a commoner was also following.

The old man looked calm, his hands were placed behind him, looking like a master.

"Are you the head of the Lin family?"

Looking at the old man leaning on a crutch in front of him, Lu Daosheng spoke indifferently.
